<USER_REQUEST>
You are a participant in a short perception study. Answer exactly as asked.

Quick task, first impressions please.
Each item below shows symbols in a sequence with one gap, marked GAP.
For each item, answer with one of:
  - "between": up to three symbols that could fill the gap, most fitting first
  - "none": true, if nothing seems to fit there
"none" is expected often and is fully valuable.
Any symbol may be proposed, including ones not shown; it may have no name.
Go by first impressions, and judge each item on its own rather than building a scheme across items.

Items:
{"id": 0, "s": ["🀉", "GAP", "🀊", "🀋"]}
{"id": 1, "s": ["🄈", "GAP", "𝟟"]}
{"id": 2, "s": ["🄁", "🄂", "GAP", "🄃", "🄅"]}
{"id": 3, "s": ["🞢", "GAP", "🞣", "🞤"]}

Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"answers": [ ... ]}, one entry per item, each one of: {"id": <id>, "between": [...]} or {"id": <id>, "none": true}.
</USER_REQUEST>
